reply: [{"query": "根据GVP Module IX，EudraVigilance数据分析中用于判定潜在信号的PRR、IC025等比例失衡统计阈值具体数值是多少？", "query_en": "According to GVP Module IX, what are the specific disproportionality statistical threshold values (e.g. PRR or IC025) used to determine a potential signal in EudraVigilance data analysis?", "topic": "比例失衡统计阈值数值", "absence_terms": ["PRR", "IC025", "threshold", "disproportionality"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 14, "text": "The selection of drug-event combinations for further review should be based on scientific judgement taking into account, e.g. the number of cases and relevant statistical measures, the known safety profile of the medicinal product, the clinical relevance"}, "rationale": "文档在多处讨论EudraVigilance比例失衡分析和信号检测方法，但仅提及“scientific judgement”和“relevant statistical measures”，从未给出具体的PRR、IC025等数值阈值，这类具体统计参数属于该文档体裁下用户合理期待但未提供的内容。"}, {"query": "若上市许可持有人未能在GVP Module IX规定的时限内完成信号确认或提交独立信号通报，该指南是否规定了具体的罚款或行政处罚措施？", "query_en": "If a marketing authorisation holder fails to complete signal confirmation or submit a standalone signal notification within the timelines set out in GVP Module IX, does the guideline specify any fines or administrative penalties?", "topic": "违反信号管理时限的处罚措施", "absence_terms": ["penalty", "fine", "sanction", "infringement"], "nearest_clause": null, "rationale": "文档详细规定了信号确认、通报及处理的各项时限（如30天、3个工作日等），但全文未涉及任何针对未遵守这些时限的罚款或处罚条款，这类合规后果通常由成员国立法而非本操作性指南规定。"}]
